note: Pine-ridge SRA on a rocky escarpment ~10 mi S of Gering on NE-71, with a nature center (park HQ), hiking trails and a shooting range. Primitive sites along the interior park roads; NGPC: the summit access road's turnaround is extremely sharp and not for large RVs or long trailers. Most sites are small; a few pull-throughs fit a short rig like the 23-ft EKKO. Three primitive restrooms; drinking water near the Nature Center. Nearest dump station in Gering. --Claude
summary: Still NGPC (Active SRA, on the 2025 grid). 12 Basic sites, no electric, half reservable on ReserveAmerica (180-day window, 1 day ahead) / half FCFS, water near the Nature Center, open year round (RA): confirmed. Fees left. Fit for 23 ft NOT confirmed by any page (RA gives no lengths; NGPC's 2022 map labels its camping 'Tent Camping'). Pin is the Nature Center lot.
flags: FIT / INCLUSION weak spot: no page gives a site or rig length. ReserveAmerica's 12 Basic site pages say Drive-In, 2 vehicles, but list no driveway length or equipment. NGPC's 2022 layout map labels both of its camping symbols 'Basic Nonreservable Tent Camping', and NGPC warns that the summit access road is 'not accessible to large recreational vehicles ... since the turnaround is extremely sharp'. The stored inclusion_evidence ('RVs to 30 ft') and the note's 'a few pull-through sites fit a small RV' have no source I could find. sites.pull_through true (derived from that note) is left alone but is unsupported. Worth a human look; I'd keep it with the caveat unless a source says tents only.

BOOKING CONFLICT (minor): NGPC says half the sites are reservable. ReserveAmerica lists all 12 Basic sites as 'Site-Specific', and NGPC's 2022 map marks only 'Nonreservable' symbols. I've written NGPC's statement (reservable, fcfs some_sites).
